description: Ninja Gaiden Black (Xbox, 2005) statically recompiled into native Linux and Windows builds, with an experimental Android port, drawn by its own Vulkan renderer. A steady 60 fps, widescreen and ultrawide, keyboard and mouse, touch controls on Android, Steam Deck ready. Bring your own copy of the game.
